notes.title: Board Game Contest
notes.content:
Want to see your board game come to life?

Design your game using Tabletop Creator, record a short video showing your idea and how you're building it with the tool and enter for a chance to win!

How the contest works:

The Tabletop Creator Contest runs every month!
Each month, we select one winner who receives a professional prototype of their game.
Then in December, all monthly winners will enter a final round, where a jury will select one grand winner:

 Monthly prize: a prototype of your game
 Annual prize: full production of your game

How to join:

[olist] Create a video (at least 1 minute long) that shows:

 Your game idea and core mechanics
 How you're building your prototype using Tabletop Creator
 What makes your game special and exciting
 Post the video on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Twitter (X)

 Use the hashtag #TabletopCreator and tag us
 Or: send us your video and we’ll upload it to our social media for you
 Fill out the submission form by including either the link to your social media post or directly uploading the video.[/olist]


📌 See full details: https://tabletop-creator.com/board-game-contest/

notes.title: New Update (2022.1.14a)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This minor maintenance update with several bugfixes also contains a new feature that allows you to set leading zeros in some special variables (like #, @, ##, @@, amount).

The format to enable the leading zeros is to append "|0000" (from 1 up to 4 zeros).

Example (using the "item number in set" special variable):

 [table]
    [tr]
        [th]Format[/th]
        [th]Result[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{#}[/td]
        [td]3[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{#|0}[/td]
        [td]3[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{#|00}[/td]
        [td]03[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{#|000}[/td]
        [td]003[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{#|0000}[/td]
        [td]0003[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
Read more about variables in the official manual / documentation 📘


Full release notes:

✨ New Features
 Allow to set leading zeros in some special variables (amount, item numbers, total item counts).

🔧 Improvements
 Improve project load performance when data import screens warmup is enabled.
 Hide right menus on mouse cursor screen exit on the start screen.
 Update to Unity 2021.3.9f1 LTS.

🐛 Bugfixes
 Fix some panel inspectors property reset buttons not working.
 Fix UI state bug when creating new sets on Excel data import preventing to show their items.
 Fix occasional bug when importing Excel sheets containing cells with formulas.

notes.title: Tabletop Creator is coming!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28448748/31bdfe47514bcd0fcf23a09896d4b00d25d5a6a7.png

Hi everyone!

As many of you may already know, we have been working on Tabletop Creator, optimizing the workflow in every step needed from concept to production with everything we learnt from Card Creator in order to enable you to develop your game in the best possible way.

When can I try it?

As a feature of the Steam Tabletop Fest, we've made available a Tabletop Creator Demo. It's already up on the Steam store page for you to try.

This version is free but with limited features and watermarks when exporting, but will be just enough to give you a good feel about the power of the application. Go check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/861590/Tabletop_Creator/

Tabletop Creator Kickstarter coming soon!

We want to launch this project on Kickstarter since it's a global nexus for tabletop gaming enthusiasts all around the world. It's a perfect fit for Tabletop Creator!

Follow Tabletop Creator on Kickstarter to be notified as soon as it launches!

notes.title: Tabletop Creator DEMO coming soon!
notes.content:
Dear Designers,

It has been a long time since our last news, we really appreciate your patience and all the interest in the project we are receiving!

"We have been so worried!... Anyway, what have you been doing? When is Tabletop Creator going to be released?"

We haven't stopped for months! We have been really busy working on...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39714325/cefa983f5c14b5036d6bf47936603b340eaf1d08.png

Reventure: Orbtale is a tabletop game based on Reventure's universe, and it has been our first published tabletop game.

"Ok, great. And could you explain WHY haven't you been working on Tabletop Creator!?"

The answer is... we did it as well! Because to develop Orbtale we have been using... (dramatic pause)

Tabletop Creator!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39714325/4a4ebf5c8e3f0181ec9c950ba71922f8eb9f82c8.png

Tabletop Creator integrates a full professional workflow, so we went through a real tabletop game project and we put all our experience and learning within Tabletop Creator, adding new workflows and features and reorienting other ones.

"Does that mean the Tabletop Creator it's already done? When is it going to be published?"

Actually, Tabletop Creator is still under development and is not ready to be published, but we have some good news!

First, we have opened new Discord channels at our community server, so you all have a proper place to meet, comment and ask questions. Also we are going to start being more active, sharing with you news and other aspects related to Tabletop Creator development!

"Awesome! But still, when is it going to be published?"

Well, you probably already saw this announcement title... we plan to release a first Tabletop Creator free demo at the end of October!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39714325/6d6c82282f313dc1896b22b2b04b9b3a7a25f3b8.png

As a demo, it will have a couple of limitations, but will let you experience the new workflow and results. We are really looking forward to hearing your comments, suggestions and feedback!

"Wait! I have more questions!"

Then wishlist Tabletop Creator and join our Discord community! We are waiting for you ;)

📌 official Tabletop Creator Discord server 💬
